N° 05Digital library2026

La Case des Savoirs

A library to build, transmit and modernise our communities.

Visit terra-village-reads.lovable.app →How to use itWatch the purpose

I

Purpose

Gather practical books and training manuals in one calm reading room, in French and English, for people building villages, farms and small businesses.

II

The problem

PDFs shared in messaging apps get lost and printed manuals are expensive to move. Readers need a shelf they can return to, with their place kept and their notes saved.

III

What I built

A mobile first library with featured books, search across chapters, a reader with adjustable modes, bookmarks, highlights and notes, a subscription for the full shelf, an admin dashboard to publish chapter by chapter, and a door to submit a project.

IV

How it works

Books are stored as chapters so they load fast on a weak connection and can be updated without re-uploading a file. Progress follows the account.

V

Craft

Chalk green and ivory, a serif with the gravity of a printed page, and a lot of white space.

VI

The purpose, in motion

A short motion design made for this book: four beats, one drawn shape each, the reason the project exists. Tap it to step through.

In short
